text:
Jules (Customer Success): MonarchPay reporting high tail latency (~20-30s p95/p99) and intermittent 503s from Dedicated pool eu-west-1 since ~08:40 UTC. They've escalated to P1. Can we get an owner + immediate workaround timeline?

Alex (Eng Platform): Assigning Priya + Sam to triage. Priya can you lead incident-level mitigation (routing/rollback)? Sam take infra scaling & metrics; Ravi pls sanity-check model side.

Priya (Eng Oncall): On it. First quick checks:
- Are 503s from backend timeouts or proxy?
- Any recent canary/rollouts to that pool in last 2 hours?

Sam (Eng SRE): Looking at cluster metrics now — pool3 autoscaler spiking, OOM kills on a few nodes, CPU fine but GPUs are saturated on a small subset. Throwing some queries to logs.

Priya (Eng Oncall): Run this on the control plane to pull recent pod restarts/log tailing:
```
kubectl -n dedicated get pods -l pool=pool3 -o wide
kubectl -n dedicated logs $(kubectl -n dedicated get pods -l pool=pool3 -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') -c runtime | tail -n 200```

deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-2028 (monarchpay-dedicated-latency). Pager notified.

Ravi (Eng ML): Quick ML note — I see higher KV-cache memory growth for the quantized variant we rolled last week; some requests are blowing past expected sequence lengths which can spike cache size. If the runtime sees huge KV growth it can cause scheduling stalls -> 503s.

Alex (Eng Platform): Good catch. Immediate options: 1) route MonarchPay to model-legacy-quant (less KV) as fallback, 2) enable short-term burst capacity to reduce queueing, 3) rollback recent model change if it's the root. Which is fastest?

Priya (Eng Oncall): Plan:
- 08:50 UTC (T+10m) -> route MonarchPay traffic to fallback model-legacy-quant in eu-west-1 (quick config change).
- 09:00 UTC (T+30m) -> enable burst capacity for their dedicated pool (add 2 nodes, scale up).
- 09:30 UTC -> if symptoms continue, route traffic to us-east-1 fallback region and start controlled rollback of the quantized variant.
I will own the routing changes + capacity toggles.

Sam (Eng SRE): I'll trigger the capacity bump and monitor autoscaler behaviour. Also prepping a hotfix for the scheduler backpressure bug we saw in canary (PR ready to cut if needed). Ping me for the PR: #5123 needs review.

Ravi (Eng ML): I'll build a trimmed KV profile and a smaller-heap model-variant for MonarchPay to reduce cache churn. Can push variant and smoke-test in < 2h. For now routing to legacy-quant should reduce pressure.

Jules (Customer Success): Thank you. I'll message the MonarchPay TAM with the plan: switch to fallback model + capacity bump, ETA 30m for mitigation, full follow-up in 4h.

Alex (Eng Platform): Ownership recap:
- Priya: lead mitigation + routing (immediate)
- Sam: infra scaling + monitor + PR #5123 owner
- Ravi: model-variant + smoke tests (2h)
- Alex: coordinate customer comms and escalate to platform leadership if we need cross-region routing
- Jules: customer comms & status updates

oncall-bot: Join zoom: https://zoom.redwood.com/INC-2028 (auto-created)

Priya (Eng Oncall): Executed routing change at 08:50 UTC -> MonarchPay now on model-legacy-quant. Initial telemetry shows p95 down from ~22s to ~3.5s for a small sample. Continuing watch.

Sam (Eng SRE): Capacity bump completed 08:59 UTC: +2 nodes to pool3. No new OOMs in the last 4 mins, queue depth decreased. Monitoring logs for 503s.

Ravi (Eng ML): Running smoke tests on the trimmed variant in staging now. If green I'll promote to canary and coordinate cutover with Priya.

Alex (Eng Platform): PR #5123 (scheduler backpressure fix) is ready for review — @Alex @Sam please take 10m. If merged we'll canary to pool3 tonight.

Jules (Customer Success): MonarchPay acknowledges mitigation and appreciates the fast response. They've requested a postmortem and a timeline for a permanent fix (reduce recurrence risk). I'll take notes for the postmortem doc.

Priya (Eng Oncall): Current status at 09:10 UTC: mitigation holding, customer traffic stable on fallback. Next steps: keep monitoring for 2h, Ravi to cut model-variant canary in 2h, Sam to keep autoscaler tuned, schedule postmortem. I'll close the incident if stable by 11:30 UTC unless we see regressions.

Sam (Eng SRE): +1. I'll add a short-runbook entry for capacity burst workflow so CS can trigger if needed.

Ravi (Eng ML): Canary build green at 10:35 UTC; requesting Priya for coordinated canary cut at 10:45 UTC.

Priya (Eng Oncall): Roger. Scheduling canary cut at 10:45. Noted: if p95 > 5s or any 503s then rollback immediately.

Alex (Eng Platform): Great work team. After we stabilize, let's scope a follow-up: persistent fix (KV-growth guardrails + scheduler backpressure fix) + test coverage for long-sequence workloads. Target: PRs and rollout plan by EOD.

Jules (Customer Success): I'll collect timelines and confirm with MonarchPay: mitigation complete, follow-up plan due EOD.

(END THREAD)
